_doc: Wave 2 binding rules. Each row maps a requirement (matched by req_id_pattern, source_doc_pattern, section_pattern, or line range) to runtime evidence. coverage='full' flips the row to PASS in the matrix (subject to runtime_artifact_glob resolving). coverage='partial' flips it to PARTIAL with binding-derived actual_* fields (more honest than the keyword heuristic). First match wins — put narrow rules first.

bindings.rationale: 99.4 OTEL Trace and Span Tree Proof § 'parent IDs form a tree' + 'no false-positive spans on bypassed layers' is directly proven by validate_trace_tree, which enforces exactly-1-root, parent_span_id references emitted span_ids, consistent trace_id across spans, and canonical layer order. T5/T6/T7/T8 negative controls prove the validator catches each tampered case via the EXPECTED mechanism (reason_match=True). Runtime artifact: per-app trace JSON.

99.4 lines 89-92 require span-level attributes (capability_token_ref, sandbox_envelope_ref, evidence_contract_ref, commit_request_id, UWG receipt). validate_trace_tree only checks structural tree validity — span-attribute validators are not yet wired. Honest PARTIAL — promote to full when those validators land.
bindings.validator: validate_trace_tree (structural only); span-attribute validators NOT yet implemented

bindings.rationale: 99.5 Deterministic Replay Proof § 'Same ValidatedRequest + same L1PlanContract + same policy/snapshot must produce identical content' is literally what validate_replay does: re-runs the scenario with the registered seed, hashes ValidatedRequest, L1PlanContract, RouteContract (volatile-stripped), and asserts identical content. T9/T10/T11 negative controls prove tamper detection via 'content hash drift' (reason_match=True).

99.3 Contract Emission and Handoff Proof requires every downstream artifact to reference upstream contract IDs and preserve request_id/trace_root/policy_hash/blueprint_hash chain. validate_artifact_inventory walks artifact_inventory.json and recomputes sha256 of every referenced file against the recorded content_hash — any chain break is a fail_reason. T1/T2/T3/T4/T12 controls prove tamper detection.

99.8 Acceptance Commands and Proof Bundle prescribes the exact shell invocation `python -m apps_shared.proof.proof_runner --full ...` and the proof bundle contents. The harness IS that command and emits proof_summary.json + proof_report.md as the bundle. CI gate check_apps_runtime_proof.py wraps it.
bindings.validator: apps_shared.proof.proof_runner --full (8 apps, 13 controls each, all fully_caught)

bindings.rationale: 99 README § CI Acceptance Gates per 99.8. The CI gate ops_scripts/ci/check_apps_runtime_proof.py exists, is wired into pre-commit, and exits non-zero when the harness fails.

99.9 Mutation Testing Boundary Faults requires that boundary mutations be caught. The negative-control suite is exactly that: 13 typed mutations × 8 apps = 104 tamper tests, all 104 fully_caught (verdict + mechanism). Hypothesis property test adds ~360 additional corrupted-input cases per run.
bindings.negative_control: all 13 controls (T1-T13) per app; 8 apps; Hypothesis property tests
